_comment: LIGHTKEEPER T11 Policy Gatekeeper — versioned policy. Every decision is logged with this policy's sha256, so a policy change can never silently re-write history. Fail-closed: the gate refuses to run without a valid policy file.

actions._comment: Action allowlist. 'deploy' and 'batch' are deliberately ABSENT (owned by other tasks) — proposing them DENIES with rule name action_allowlist.

networks._comment: Only Atlantic testnet. Mainnet actions are REFUSED outright (see mainnet.enabled=false) — the 4th mandatory SkillEngine pre-check.

prechecks._comment: The 4 mandatory SkillEngine Write Operation Pre-checks, enforced on the execute path.
prechecks._fee_reserve_human: 0.001 PHRS reserved for gas above the action value

cooldown._comment: Minimum seconds between two APPROVED writes (anti-flood). Read from the audit trail.

destination_allowlist._comment: Write-action recipients. Anything else DENIES with rule name destination_allowlist.

gas._comment: Sanity cap on gas price read live from the RPC (pre-check condition C1).

per_action_caps._comment: Max native value per action type, in wei. Time-window totals reuse the same caps.

contract_call._human: no native value may accompany contract calls

erc20_transfer._human: no native value may accompany token transfers

selector_allowlist._comment: contract_call actions may only invoke these 4-byte selectors.

time_window._comment: Writes are only approved inside these UTC hours (inclusive start, exclusive end). Demo evidence runs happened inside this window; the deny path is covered in unit tests.

token_allowlist._comment: Token contracts permitted in erc20_transfer actions.

sender._comment: Only this signer may execute approved actions (pre-check #2: env key must derive to this address).
